svg.title: CleanerSharpApi thumbnail
svg.desc: Three stacked layers, Endpoint, Service and Repository, above a Storage drum. A request passes down through each layer. The Service layer can refuse by throwing OperationDeniedException. Below, the four CRUD interfaces every layer shares: ICrud, ICrudAsync, ICrudMany and ICrudManyAsync.
